name: Borvo the Hutt's freighter
description: These freighters were operated by the smuggler Borvo the Hutt of Naboo, one of which acted as his personal transport. They were used for smuggling for Borvo's Nal Raka Criminal Empire. Borvo donated three to the Royal Naboo Security Forces to hold liberated slaves but betrayed the Security Forces. Gavyn Sykes tracked Borvo's transport to Porso Hill and destroyed it, forcing Borvo to flee.
